ideas.pitch: An AI-powered image clustering and severity scoring pipeline that automatically groups citizen-submitted pothole and infrastructure reports to eliminate duplicate tickets for municipal authorities.
ideas.problem_statement: PS01 — Digital Reporting and Resolution System for Public Infrastructure Damage
ideas.title: CivicLens AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the pattern of winning civic tech apps by providing a live, working dashboard for municipal authorities with clear automated deduplication metrics.

ideas.pitch: An interactive, task-based career exposure platform where students complete 10-minute micro-simulations of real industry roles to receive authentic skill readiness scores.
ideas.problem_statement: PS02 — Career Path Clarity and Realistic Exposure System for Students
ideas.title: SkillPath Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses judge priorities around practical educational impact by replacing passive career quizzes with active, verifiable skill simulations.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web app and SMS integration tool connecting informal waste pickers with local apartment complexes for scheduled, optimized recyclable pickups.
ideas.problem_statement: PS03 — Formal Integration System for Informal Waste Collectors into the Recycling Value Chain
ideas.title: KachraKnect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers clear measurable social and economic impact by formalizing informal workflows and quantifying waste diverted from landfills.

ideas.pitch: A smartphone-accelerometer background logging prototype that passively detects severe road anomalies and automatically queues up structured repair reports for city engineers.
ideas.problem_statement: PS01 — Digital Reporting and Resolution System for Public Infrastructure Damage
ideas.title: RoadGuard Live
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leans into a working live demo that transforms standard smartphone sensors into active municipal infrastructure monitors without needing custom hardware.

ideas.pitch: A transparent tracking dashboard that aggregates recycling collection volumes from informal collectors and issues verified ESG impact certificates for local businesses.
ideas.problem_statement: PS03 — Formal Integration System for Informal Waste Collectors into the Recycling Value Chain
ideas.title: EcoValue Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the proven formula of pairing local operational utility with a clean analytics dashboard that non-technical judges can easily understand and evaluate.
